profile.headline: Software Engineer | React, Redux, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, SQL, Mongoose, MongoDB, Git, HTML5, CSS3, Node.js, jquery, Java
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with experience in Ruby, Ruby on Rails, React/Redux, MongoDB, Node.js, HTML/CSS and much more. I thoroughly enjoy the challenges that come with working on a new problem or project and coming to sensible and efficient solutions. I enjoy the work so much it doesn't feel like work.

I graduated Caldwell University with a Bachelors degree in Computer Science and another in Financial Economics. Recently, I graduated from a Full Stack Software Engineering Bootcamp with App Academy where I spent anywhere from 80-100 hours a week sharpening my developer skills.

Before becoming a Software Engineer I was a Regional Sales Manager for Verizon FiOS where I overlooked and trained teams in New York, New Jersey, and California.

When I'm not coding, I'm either in the gym or at home or a coffee shop learning something new!
